hill_start_command — DRIVE long op

• Data kinds: scalar × scalar × scalar × scalar → any

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.hill_start_command(t_release: 'float', tau: 'float', a_drive: 'float', b_hold: 'float', a_creep: 'float' = 0.0, technique: 'str' = 'gap', v_cruise: 'Optional[float]' = None) -> 'Callable' (to call the implementation directly, import drivelong; drivelong.hill_start_command(t_release: 'float', tau: 'float', a_drive: 'float', b_hold: 'float', a_creep: 'float' = 0.0, technique: 'str' = 'gap', v_cruise: 'Optional[float]' = None) -> 'Callable'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("hill_start_command"))

Usage

Command for a hill start. Holds until t_release (creep + braking b_hold).

• technique="gap": release the brake at t_release and drive a_drive after τ (while the foot switches pedals = the car rolls back; the closed form is hill_start_rollback).

• technique="overlap": from t_release for τ, keep the brake on while pressing the accelerator (drive a_drive), then release the brake after τ (what driving schools teach: "press the accelerator, then release the brake"). If drive > slope, rollback is 0.

If v_cruise is given, drive stops once that speed is reached (coasting).
